stories.title: Online store Revibed to shut down at end of 2026
stories.summary: Revibed, the online store that crowdfunded the digitisation of rare vinyl, cassettes and CDs and sold the files, will close at the end of 2026. It says its business model is 'simply not economically viable' and has asked users to spend their remaining balance before then. An RA investigation last December found the store had not cleared master rights for the recordings it sold. Revibed says it plans to return with an artist-focused streaming product.

stories.title: Rachael Pazdan named New York's first executive director of music
stories.summary: New York City appointed Rachael Pazdan, former music director at Le Poisson Rouge, as its first executive director of music on 23 November. The new role sits in the Mayor's Office of Media and Entertainment and is meant to make live performances easier to organise and to create more opportunities for musicians. It follows Eric Thor's appointment as director of the city's Office of Nightlife.
